summary: Implementation made meaningful progress by adding a capability registry, REST/CLI/MCP introspection checks, explicit CLI-absence handling, MCP safety-boundary assertions, and a production fix requiring idempotency_key on the seven MCP mutating control tools. It does not yet fully satisfy the saved plan because executable parity coverage remains representative rather than complete across every implemented safe read/control surface, and the workspace has no validation artifact proving the requested focused and broad gates.
gaps: Parameterize request payload, response payload, idempotency replay/conflict, If-Match stale/malformed/version conflict, reason-code, invalid-state, and structured-error contract cases across every registered implemented safe read/control surface. Current tests primarily exercise cancel plus a small subset of stop/destroy/remonitor/request_validation/create/adopt, leaving refresh, rebase, retry, many read query parameters, and most read-only registry rows covered only by metadata/schema or older MCP tests.

Extend auth-failure parity to every protected REST route in the registry and every CLI command that calls protected REST endpoints. Current auth contract coverage proves the shared dependency through a few routes and CLI remonitor propagation, but the saved plan requires protected REST surfaces and overlapping CLI commands not to drift individually.

Add or preserve concrete validation evidence under the AWF validation phase.
